99:t_2:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「If you'd given me just a little more time, I could have achieved our objective...」

99:t_2:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Forgive me for interfering. As the one entrusted with all of $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces, I wanted to do my utmost to carry out our mission too.」

99:t_2:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Supreme Commander $$ハマーン$$... Please explain why you tried to bring $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ into our fold.」

99:t_2:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「They had their own intelligence network and connections in $$ＡＤＷ$$. For these past two months... they've used them to keep disrupting us despite their small force...」

99:t_2:10.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You chose to win them over rather than defeat them?」

99:t_2:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Precisely. Realizing their ideal of eradicating war is also $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s desire.」

99:t_2:13.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you find it suspicious, go ahead and report it to the Leader.」

99:t_2:14.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I shall. Colonel $$フル・フロンタル$$ is $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s current leader, after all.」

99:t_2:15.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't look so fierce. I acknowledge him too. That's why I'm serving as commander on the front lines.」

99:t_2:16.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Isn't that other man the $$赤い彗星$$ to you, Supreme Commander?」

99:t_2:17.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Are you trying to provoke me?」

99:t_2:19.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Never speak of that man who betrayed the $$スペースノイド$$s again.」

99:t_2:21.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...It seems $c is heading for Earth...」

99:t_2:22.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Shall we pursue them in the $$レウルーラ$$?」

99:t_2:23.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「No... I won't provoke $$サイデリアル$$ with a careless move. Leave it to the forces responsible for that area.」

99:t_2:24.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$, continue your patrol duties from now on.」

99:t_2:25.en:
$$ヒル$$
「Where will you go, Supreme Commander?」

99:t_2:26.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll return to $$パラオ$$ for now. If $c is on the move, I must revise our strategy accordingly with the Leader.」

99:t_2:27.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「We'll take the $$レウルーラ$$ back, Captain.」

99:t_2:28.en:
$$ヒル$$
「I understand. We'll leave part of the fleet behind and return to $$パラオ$$.」

99:t_2:30.en:
$$ハマーン$$
($c... I'll have you take action for that purpose...)

99:t_2:34.en: ～$$ネェル・アーガマ$$　Captain's Quarters～

99:t_2:36.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes. We believe $$フル・フロンタル$$ is $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s current leader.」

99:t_2:37.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「After the battle at the absolute defense line, we investigated $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements, mainly in space.」

99:t_2:38.en:
$$オットー$$
「Were you operating independently of the $$地球連邦軍$$?」

99:t_2:39.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes... We also used methods the $$連邦軍$$ couldn't use.」

99:t_2:40.en:
$$オットー$$
(I hear $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ was originally a private armed organization that fought the whole world... Missions like that must be second nature to them...)

99:t_2:41.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「As you saw in today's battle, $$ハマーン・カーン$$ is Supreme Commander of $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces, but...」

99:t_2:42.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We believe the Leader, $$フル・フロンタル$$, holds all the power behind her.」

99:t_2:43.en:
$$オットー$$
「But why? During the $$時獄戦役$$, $$フロンタル$$ was supposed to be $$ハマーン$$'s subordinate in $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

99:t_2:44.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$フロンタル$$ must have had something powerful enough to overturn that relationship.」

99:t_2:46.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We couldn't find conclusive proof, but...」

99:t_2:47.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We believe it was probably a deal with $$サイデリアル$$.」

99:t_2:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That is probably why the colonies are excluded from the Empire's sphere of operations.」

99:t_2:50.en:
$$オットー$$
「What was his bargaining chip? What did $$フロンタル$$ use to win the Empire's favor?」

99:t_2:51.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Unfortunately, we don't know that much. But I'm sure you can imagine the worst possible answer, Captain $$オットー$$...」

99:t_2:52.en:
$$オットー$$
「...He offered to help them rule Earth... No... At worst, he offered to exterminate the $$アースノイド$$s...」

99:t_2:54.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ has strengthened its forces over these two months and is about to resume full-scale operations.」

99:t_2:55.en:
$$オットー$$
「So $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ detected that movement and tried to join us.」

99:t_2:56.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That was part of the reason...」

99:t_2:58.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「《$$ヴェーダ$$》 has fallen into $$サイデリアル$$'s hands.」

99:t_2:60.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$'s power was a major reason we could continue operating independently over these past two months.」

99:t_2:61.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But now that it's in enemy hands, we must change the way we fight.」

99:t_2:62.en:
$$オットー$$
「But $$ヴェーダ$$ was the cornerstone of the $$地球連邦軍$$'s command system too...」

99:t_2:63.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's why I believe it was protected by optical camouflage and various other means. Those defenses must have been breached.」

99:t_2:64.en:
$$オットー$$
「In that case, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ may be resuming its operations because it knows about this.」

99:t_2:65.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We must quickly determine $$フル・フロンタル$$'s intentions. Depending on what we find, we may have to attack $$ネオ・ジオン$$ before the $$新地球皇国$$.」

99:t_2:66.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then we should head to $$パラオ$$, believed to be $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s current base...」

99:t_2:67.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No... That asteroid has become a fortress to replace $$アクシズ$$. With our forces, we probably couldn't even get close.」

99:t_2:68.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I propose we descend to North America.」

99:t_2:69.en:
$$オットー$$
「The remaining $$連邦軍$$ have gathered on that continent and are locked in a seesaw battle with the Empire, but...」

99:t_2:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That is exactly why $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will send troops there too.」

99:t_2:72.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll descend to North America.」
「We'll descend to Japan.」

99:t_2:73.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand. We'll descend to North America too.」

99:t_2:74.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$新日本$$ should be able to hold the front in Japan.」

99:t_2:75.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I hear 'he' is in $$新日本$$. I'm sure they'll fight to the end, even against the $$新地球皇国$$.」

99:t_2:76.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then we'll change this ship's course to descend to North America.」

99:t_2:77.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I understand. Let's gather as much information on $$ネオ・ジオン$$ as we can before we fight the Empire.」

99:t_2:78.en:
$$オットー$$
(Will we be fighting over $$ラプラスの箱$$ again...? What on earth is it...?)

99:t_2:79.en:
$$オットー$$
(Are they saying it has the power to change the world even in this situation...?)

99:t_2:80.en:
$$オットー$$
「No... We'll descend to Japan. I'm concerned about the $$ジオフロント$$, and above all, the Empire is reaching for $$新日本$$.」

99:t_2:81.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we leave things as they are, the Empire will gain complete control of the Pacific.」

99:t_2:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's ask the $$連邦軍$$ in North America to investigate $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

99:t_2:83.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I understand. Then we'll descend to North America to cooperate with the $$連邦軍$$.」

99:t_2:84.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand. Please contact us if you receive any new information.」

99:t_2:85.en:
$$オットー$$
(But to think we'll be fighting over $$ラプラスの箱$$ again... What on earth is it...?)

99:t_2:86.en:
$$オットー$$
(Are they saying it has the power to change the world even in this situation...?)

99:t_2:90.en: ～$$ローナン・マーセナス$$'s Residence～
